profile.headline: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer - R&D
profile.summary:
I am the founder and owner of the technology, service and retail startup company, Nexus Entertainment, LLC. We specialize in automation software and hardware solutions for gaming entertainment to provide unique experiences. I have a diverse background in business management and computer science.

My experience includes a wide range as a lead full stack engineer, technical architect,  experience designer, marketing, data analytics and analysis and techincal research implementing web and mobile applications. 

UI
o	Thymeleaf, jsps, javascript, html5, css3, angular, react, bootstrap, nextjs. 

Web Application
o	SOAP and API services utilizing Java, Spring framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, maven, python, c, c++

Mobile Application
o	iOS & Android, objective c, swift, react native

Database
o	MyBatis, Hibernate, Spring jdbc, postgres, sql, MongoDb, DynamoDB, RDS

Deployment & Continuous Delivery
o	Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Docker, Jenkinsfile, Jenkins, Git Webhooks, AWS

Machine Learning & OCR
o	Google Tesseract, OpenCv, TensorFlow

Source Code management
o	GitHub, GitLab

AWS
o lambda, lamda@edge, sagemaker, dynamodb, rds, elasticache, s3, cloudfront, cloud watch, elastic container service, route53, lightsail. 

Architecture
o serverless, microservices, single page application

Marketing, Data & Analytics
o Adobe analytics, Google analytics, fullstory, tealeaf, mail chimp, optimizely. 

Testing Frameworks
o Jest, selenium, junit, Google lighthouse

Research
o human computer interaction, experience design.

I would like opportunities to apply my full stack development experience, to challenge myself by learning new and emerging technologies and programming languages or to combine my degree in management within the field of technology.

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer - R&D
positions.description:
As a seasoned Lead Full Stack Software Engineer, I spearhead projects from idea conception to MVP. My approach integrates a strong technical foundation with a strategic focus on human-centered design, ensuring the delivery of robust and scalable web and mobile applications that enhance user engagement and satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead a dynamic team of developers in the design, development, and deployment of comprehensive software solutions spanning both front-end and back-end technologies.
- Collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, and stakeholders to align development objectives with business goals and user needs.
- Drive the research and adoption of cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to remain at the forefront of software development.
- Manage the full project lifecycle from concept through delivery, ensuring high-quality standards and adherence to timelines and budget.

Achievements:
- Championed the integration of human-centered design principles in the development process, resulting in a rapid experimentation and streamlined customer feedback loops
- Led multiple cross-functional teams in pivotal R&D projects that resulted in the production of patents and new market opportunities
- Enhanced business operations by implementing strategic technology solutions that improved speed to market from a year down to a few months

Skills and Technologies:
Frontend: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS
Backend: Node.js, Python, Java
Databases: SQL
Tools & Platforms: AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Kubernetes
Additional skills: Agile methodologies, (CI/CD), data analysis, Problem Solver, Research & Development, Business, Marketing, 

I am passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex problems, drive business growth, and enhance the user experience. I am currently exploring opportunities to bring my unique blend of skills to a forward-thinking team that values innovation and design.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Java · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · React.js · Python · CSS · HTML5

positions.title: Founder & Owner
positions.description: •Utilizing Corda for distributed ledger technology, python, Google's Tesseract, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Restful web services

positions.title: Lead Software Developer & Product Owner
positions.description:
Led software development and research team to develop a bilingual tutoring application and digital textbook framework targeted for the iPad. 

•Worked with a diverse team of professors and graduate and undergraduate students from various fields
•Coordinated and led development and planning meetings between development and research teams
•	Managed and reported on research and development team deadlines and performance
•Translated business and research requirements from research professors into design documentation, features and stories
•	Researched and implemented work in the field of digital textbooks to aid in the betterment of student learning.
•	Led code refactoring, modularization, optimization and testing
•	Led interviews, and user and participatory design sessions with varying age groups.
•	Led data analysis from resulting sessions and published reports and research papers
•	Led prototyping and testing of user interface and interaction elements. 
•	Utilized XML, Objective-C, MYSQL, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Javascript, Python, Restful services

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Community leader serving to act as a mentor, adviser, mediator, crisis manager, campus resource for students and code of conduct policy enforcer. Also serving as the international student liaison. 

Responsibilities:
•	Event planning for building community relationships, empowering self-authorship, and providing campus resources.
•	Meeting individually with students to gauge their goals to help them achieve them and discover their struggles to provide resources to become successful.
•	Aiding international students to transition to both America and University life on campus.
•	Mediate situations between roommate conflicts and disputes
•	Provide students with on campus resources and information about the community and their campus 
•	Enforce code of conduct policy by documenting situations in violation of policy and informing students of their violation to learn from the process.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developed new features to contribute to the open source project Hygieia. 

•Created new collector and ui widget for GitLab
•Created new collector and ui widgets for gathering reports from Jenkins including jacoco, pit, pmd, findbugs, and sonar
•Utilized Java, MongoDB, Angular, Chartist, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS3

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Developed an android based mobile application to communicate with and control military grade radios. 

•	Refactored code for scalability, modularization, readability, and improved error handling
•Presented product changes bi-weekly to business partners
•	Built out regression testing suite
•	Utilized Java, XML, SNMP4J
